Author: Stwohm (fork of yagi2/Restocker)
Name: Restocky
Changelog: 0.3.16.0 — Crystals: shards, crystals and clusters in your crystal tab and your retainers' crystal tabs now count as stock (they showed 0), the cost floor uses them, and Restock lists them (up to 9,999 per listing). Crystal restock order: your inventory, then the listing retainer, then another retainer — crystals are withdrawn from that retainer first when the listing retainer is full. Settings price floor: type a value and press Enter or click away; Manual is shown with an Auto button, empty/0/Auto returns to the cost floor. Chat: one summary message per category; Max raise lines show the prices, the % change and the limit with a [Match] link. New Stats tab (net, Profit, Earning by date range, item and retainer; Flip vs Gather) and Logs tab (activity log, 14 days, filters, copy). Stock tracking: compact five-column layout, low items first, per-source stock in the tooltip, settings behind the gear button, Pause to disable an item without deleting it, per-item notes shown on hover. 0.3.15.0 — Fix: an item could be priced as if nobody else sold it ("no competitor") when the previous row was a duplicate and Marketbuddy's automatic search was still running; Restocky now waits for that search, retries an unclear empty result once, and uses offerings that arrive late. Purchase cost now applies only to the units you bought: mixed stock (gathered + a few bought) uses the average cost of everything you hold as its floor, so a small purchase no longer pins a large gathered stack above the market; the Profit/Earning estimate splits bought and gathered units. A cost floor raise above Max raise is no longer applied automatically. Missed sales: Today / 3 days / 7 days. 0.3.14.4 — Fix: a late AllaganMarket sale notice (more than 10 minutes after the sale) could record the same sale a second time on an older or relisted stack. 0.3.14.3 — A restocked listing priced above skipped bait now shows the bait notice with [Match bait] in chat and in the Reprice tab. 0.3.14.2 — Trial items are auto-restocked like the others; set Restock to Alert on an item to keep it out. Fix: auto-restock could skip a sold-out item with an empty board (sale proceeds were off by 1 gil, so the last sale price was rejected). Items with no rival listing no longer wait 4 s and report no data when Marketbuddy opens the search. Today's lost sales match our own sales more reliably. 0.3.14.1 — Fix: items right after a duplicate row could report no market data when Marketbuddy opens Compare prices automatically; the search it opened is now used. 0.3.14.0 — Stock tracking: select several items and restock them in one run (Select low, Restock selected). Auto-restock now also works during AutoRetainer visits, one retainer at a time. [Match price] chat link and Reprice tab button for prices blocked by Max drop or Max raise: one-shot, tied to the price you reviewed. Market searches no longer collide with the previous item's results: they wait, retry on "Please wait and try your search again.", and finish sooner when no rival is listed. Market sale history that arrives late is kept.
Punchline: Restocker fork: bulk reprice with price guards, sales tracking and an optional bell auto-cycle.
Description: Personal fork of yagi2/Restocker. Reprice every retainer listing to the live market lowest -N gil with floor / max-drop guards, track each listing until it sells (reprices, competitors, days, gil), one-click full cycle and an optional timed auto-cycle at the summoning bell that waits for AutoRetainer. Timed automation is against the FFXIV ToS; use at your own risk.
